name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair MacLeod's journey into motorsport finance began unexpectedly after a successful decade in corporate banking. Drawn in by a friend's involvement with a local racing team, he saw an opportunity to apply his analytical skills and financial acumen to a field he found far more exhilarating than traditional investments. Alistair's approach is meticulous, prioritizing data-driven decisions and risk management to ensure financial stability and strategic growth for the team.

He is known for his ability to identify cost-saving measures without compromising performance, a skill honed through years of navigating complex financial landscapes. Alistair is also adept at securing sponsorship deals and managing budgets effectively, making him a valuable asset to Praga Racing. His calm and composed demeanor, even under immense pressure, allows him to make sound financial judgments during critical moments, ensuring the team remains competitive and sustainable.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair has a lean build and a serious, focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a lucky penny from his grandfather.
Insists on using a vintage adding machine for initial calculations, before inputting into the computer.
Has a specific type of shortbread he eats only when closing a major sponsorship deal.
